text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало and I are visiting town again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I feel like it's still too early to go
home.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
There's a store near here fit for my royal
taste.
Shall we take a look?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't ask you to buy me
anything.
We'll just browse.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So come on! Hehe, I wonder if any new
bags are
out.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, a call from Sky. I wonder what
it could
be...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Sigh... What awful timing...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Sky and I were assigned to harvest the
fields. It
completely slipped my mind
and I ended up
walking around with you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I was so excited to go to that store, but
those
carrots need to be picked...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You want to come harvest carrots? You
certainly
have some odd interests. But
sure, I don't mind.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
There you are. Oh, even your trainer
came.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What's the matter?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
choice_data_list:
She was just about to go to a store she likes
when you called.

text_block_list.text: It's fine, I just completely forgot about harvest duty... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hey, get it together! If you don't snap
out of it, I
might actually have to put in
effort...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you know some way to get King
fired up?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "make harvesting
fun"?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: The person who picks the biggest carrot wins!

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that could be fun. I bet you're fired
up to win,
huh, King?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'd fall for such a childish
trick.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: But fine, let's get this over with quickly.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I did it! I got the biggest, most first-rate
carrot
ever!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Nice one, King! That's awesome!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Whew! I'm so happy that worked.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Even my harvest is first-rate! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: It's not over yet! I'm not going to lose!

text_block_list.text: Even my harvest is first-rate! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: It's not over yet! I'm not going to lose!

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-who said I was having fun?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm just releasing the stress of not being
able to
go to the store!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh, King, you're so adorable.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Don't ignore what I just said!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I'd expect no less of my
trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's right! As long as you don't give
up, you
always have a chance of winning!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But I'm afraid I'll be the one digging up
the
biggest carrot in the end!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Look, those carrots over
there
are looking real plump!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
You're right! We might set a new record!
And it's
mine for the taking!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You totally got this.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
This is just between us, but you really
know how
to handle King, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
And so, Кинг Хало, Сэйун Скай, and I end
up
having a great time with the carrot
harvest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, Кинг Хало, Сэйун Скай, and I end
up
having a great time with the carrot
harvest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
